about: Wendy E. Musell is a top-rated attorney who practices law in Oakland, California. Wendy Musell focuses on Employment Litigation: Plaintiff issues. Additionally, she also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Civil Rights and Employment & Labor: Employee.

Wendy Musell received Super Lawyers designation for 2016 - 2026. She was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
She became a licensed attorney in 1999. Before practicing law, she attended law school at Northeastern University School of Law and graduated in 1999.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
